notes.title: Rumu Update 2.0 / SteamOS Release
notes.notes:
Today we push our major revision in the game engine to the public which solves most of the performance problems and visual fidelity issues faced with our initial release as well as new support for SteamOS / Linux.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30941736/9d6acdcad56eb9c8d958ce0e56eb10eccdcff25e.png[/img]

This patch includes over [i]1704[/i] code commits and changes since our last patch over the last seven months.

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] SteamOS and Linux Support
[*] Full P3 Wide Color Gamut Support on macOS in full Retina Display
[*] Full RGB Hardware Integration and now working as originally designed (thanks to Razer Inc.) - Sabrina will now take control of your RGB Peripheral devices and talk through it like she does to the strip lighting in the game
[*] Changed Renderer from Deferred to Forward. Allows for full Multisample Anti-Aliasing support and better performance
[*] New Anti-Aliasing techniques (MSAA, TAA, CTAA, SMAA). By default all the aliasing mess should now be cleaned up
[*] Added more Smart Device Interactions
[*] A completely redeveloped post processing system for Bloom and Color Grading to bring the game to more computers without compromising on visual fidelity
[*] Baked Lightmaps and Shadows. Lighting is now as we originally planned for release with baked shadows to allow the same visual look across all devices despite graphics settings changes
[*] New Loading Screen System that gives feedback about loading progress
[*] New Detective Mode highlight 
[*] Rumu can now spin when Sabrina is talking when she has restricted your movement (unless it’s a sensitive moment)
[*] Full Game Controller Support
[*] Added new Graphics options and settings
[*] New Light Shaft system for Volumetrics
[*] Now supports massively high resolution displays
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30941736/105589a29efc765ba90c4ff664a7216e366e4c57.png[/img]

[h1]Fixes and Updates[/h1]
This release fixes countless bugs here are a few major ones
[list]
[*] All Achievements can be unlocked. Fixed a few issues where in some cases a few achievements could not be unlocked unless doing multiple playthroughs
[*] Interaction design and sequence fixes
[*] All rooms in the game has had multiple fidelity passes with numerous changes for each
[*] Fixed shader performances issues
[*] Camera zoom speed and rotations now slightly slower
[*] Adjusted timing of Sabrina Dialogue for more emotional dramatic effect
[*] Steam API Updated with Steam Controller support
[*] Rumu Vacuum engine has been enhanced with new suction power, can now vacuum up generated Ice
[*] Fixed Mirror not showing Rumu’s face for some players
[*] Fixed Player Movement Stutters and issues
[*] Fixed Dream White Room fidelity and collectables
[*] Fixed issues in tutorial
[*] Detective Vision now highlights and highlights objects as Rumu’s vision expands into the scene
[*] Fixed Painting interaction problems
[*] Resolved Sound Effects cache problems, no more stutters
[*] Watering plants, all issues have been resolved
[*] Reduced Rumu movement bump sounds in emotional moments
[/list]

We hope as many people as possible can now enjoy the game without having to worry about performance or loss in visual fidelity!

notes.title: Lunar New Year Sale + Mac Release
notes.notes:

[h1]Lunar New Year Sale + Mac Release[/h1]

Hi all!

We’re stoked to release Rumu for Mac users, as well as offer the first ever discount at a hefty [b]25% off.[/b] Below are the recommended specs for Mac.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30941736/ff29207c3bddf00bac9acfe2c6d7dc7972f1d962.jpg[/img]

[b]RECOMMENDED MAC SPECS:[/b]
Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
OS: OSX 10.13 (64-bit) or newer
Processor: 2.6 GHz or equivalent
Memory: 8 GB RAM
Graphics: Metal Compatible Hardware or Hardware with OpenGL 4.1 - (AMD Radeon R9 M370X, NVIDIA GeForce GT 750M, Intel Iris Plus Graphics, AMD FirePro D700, Radeon Pro Vega 65) or better
Storage: 1 GB available space
Additional Notes: MacBook Pro (2017), iMac Pro (2017), iMac (Retina 5K, 27-inch, 2017), Mac Pro (Late 2013)

Thank you for all of the incredible support so far. We’re currently working on localising Rumu for multiple languages, as well as exploring further platform porting opportunities. You’ll be the first to know when they’re ready!

Thank you,
RH team

notes.title: Update 1.2.5
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30941736/0e96b47815d672a0129f245e836672d240d29f00.png[/img]

Hi all! Thanks for your support and feedback so far. We’ve been hard at work on some (secret) next steps for Rumu, and in the meantime with your help we’ve also made some huge optimisations and have resolved issues some users were experiencing. 

We'd also like to put the call out to the community for anyone interested in testing Rumu on Mac! We'd be happy to add you to the test branch.

Please take a look at the patch notes below, and don’t hesitate to let us know if we can help you out:

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Steam Cloud Integration
[*]Controller Support (Steam Controller, Xbox One and Xbox 360 Controllers) (Beta)
[*]RGB Support for Corsair Cue Devices
[*]RGB Support for SteelSeries GameSense Devices (Beta)
[*]Support for Alternate Vulkan Renderer (-force-vulkan on steam launch options)
[/list]

[h1]Translations Engine[/h1]
[list]
[*] We have been working on a Translation Switching Engine for Subtitles and In Game UI. 
This Update (1.2.5) does not include any alternate languages as yet, however we are excited to announce this is coming very soon and will be launching a seperate update
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
 [*]Fixed the Blinky Blue Pathing Line. No Longer Blinks
 [*]Fixed Achievement for ‘Menace to Society’ (Master Bedroom was missing)
 [*]Fixed Achievement Tracking for Secret Achievement, ‘You Blade Runner’
 [*]Fixed Day 2 progression issue in Cloakroom when lights go out.
 [*]Fixed Double Cat Day 8 White Room. There can only be one, Ada
 [*]Fixed Steam issues
 [*]Fixed Game Settings and Graphics Settings not being saved
 [*]Reset Room in Main Lab now resets HazChem for a few cases where it would be thrown off the map
 [*]Fixed Issues with Ants in Vents
 [*]Fixed Issues with Achievement Saving / Loading 
 [*]Fixed Issues with Plant Watering
[/list]

[h1]Optimizations[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed Temporary Render Texture Buffer not being released on some frames that degraded performance overtime
[*]Optimised Memory Allocations
[*]Optimised Physics
[*]Blur Menus no longer used for Low / Medium, Switched to Semi-Transparent for Optimisation
[*]Low and Medium Graphics Further Optimised
[*]Post Processing Further Optimised (AA, AO, Volumetrics)
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30941736/6eec94b8eefecd417cff1d98f71663f318ffe519.jpg[/img]

Hey all,

Thanks so much for your support so far - We’ve gathered a lot of feedback, and with your help have resolved a few key issues. Please take a look at the patch notes below

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
 [*]Added a Journal hotkey. By default this is ‘J’
 [*]“Reset Room” now puts ‘PUSH’ objects back in their starting positions in addition to Rumu.
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
 [*]Fixed Achievement Tracking for various achievements.
 [*]Fixed Camera Bug in Day 5 testing sequence where camera would focus on the edge of a room instead of on Rumu.
 [*]Fixed issue where collected items in Rumu’s Dream would not load correctly if the game was closed and reopened.
 [*]Fixed issue where some subtitles would not show.
 [*]Fixed issue with end game sequence.
 [*]Resolved many little power-routing bugs (Mostly visual).
 [*]Fixed ESC Key after Day 2 for RGB Devices.
 [*]Updated Razer Chroma SDK.
[/list]

[h1]Optimizations[/h1]
[list]
[*]Isolated and fixed memory bandwidth issues associated with too many large textures
[*]Optimised Rumu’s Face and refresh rate (Hz) depending on Graphics Settings.
[*]Low and Medium Graphics Optimised.
[*]HBAO Quality Optimised.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Date!
notes.notes:
Hello Steam friends!

The Rumu team is thrilled to finally cross the threshold from "Late 2017" into a release date.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30941736/e0133c8943a99013a37bdbd28ba4185ea280c9c1.gif[/img]

We can't wait for you all to meet Rumu [b]NEXT WEEK[/b]!  

We wanted to take this opportunity to introduce ourselves, the team who will be here for you on the Steam back end during and post-launch. We'll be here for any questions, concerns or comments you have to share with us. We want your experience with Rumu to be the best, most heartbreaking, most adorable experience it can be.

We also offer our services as an emotional support group should you need it after you finish the game...

See you soon!

[b]Ally[/b] - [i]Gamerunner[/i]
[b]Adam[/b] - [i]Lead Design[/i]
[b]Dan[/b] - [i]Senior Programmer[/i]
[b]Alex[/b] - [i]Game Designer[/i]
